generationBrief: One standalone landscape 16:9 illustration per moment, no text or UI. Preserve the same late-thirties hero, charcoal hooded jacket, jeans, dark boots and single worn black backpack. Ordinary Warsaw neighborhood park footpath after midnight, trees and low bushes, distant apartment windows and soft dull amber lamps. Muted slate blue-gray, charcoal, gray-brown and dull olive; readable face/clothes and tonal shadows. No horror, vivid orange foliage, theatrical spotlight, orange/teal grading, rain or fog effects. Opening: unexplained sound and alert turn, no visible source. Inspection: approach after calling out, then see one ordinary tabby at the edge of the bushes, slight relief. Waiting: stand motionless partly sheltered by a tree, listen without revealing the source. Departure: brisk natural stride on a longer lamp-lit path, no running or pursuit. Only the inspection result shows the cat.
packaging: RGB WebP masters quality 90 plus proportional 480/768/1024px WebP variants quality 80; encoding/resizing only. Existing runtime asset names are replaced and registered in imageManifest.json. On-demand loading and content-hash cache invalidation remain unchanged.
